messages:
debra: quick poll  final copy for v8.0.1 internal blast. need blurb + pinned artifact + confirm who posts. can we run a deploy-bot staging dry-run?
omar: blurb draft: 'v8.0.1: adaptive batching + kernel selection to reduce tail latency. No API changes; backward compatible.' short and sweet.
yasmin: please include Dedicated pin string for account teams.
debra: pinned artifact -> runtime-x@v8.0.1 (sha: f9a12bd). adding rollback: auto rollback to v8.0.0 if 5m error rate > 0.7% OR p95 latency +40% for 5m.
yasmin: can we also set initial alert softening for first 6m instead of muting? oncall prefers raised thresholds.
sre-oncall: yep. we'll set error threshold to 1.1% and p95 delta +60% for first 6m. not muting, just reducing noise.
debra: @deploy-bot run a staging dry-run for thread 9912345678 so docs can copy verbatim.
deploy-bot: staging dry-run started for thread 9912345678. will emit messages flagged [STAGING DRY-RUN]. ETA ~60s.
deploy-bot: dry-run output:
- "[STAGING DRY-RUN] Release v8.0.1 scheduled. Canary: us-west 20m -> ramp to 50% over 15m. Pin: runtime-x@v8.0.1 (f9a12bd)"
- "Rollback policy: 5m error rate > 0.7% OR p95 latency increases > 40% -> rollback to v8.0.0"
- "Initial alert adjustment: error_rate threshold -> 1.1% for first 6m; p95 delta threshold -> +60% for first 6m"
- "Owners: debra (release), yasmin (docs & accounts), omar (deploy), sre-oncall (pager)"
yasmin: looks good. add blackout: avoid EU midnight 00:00-03:00 UTC for canary. i'll paste config snippet into the appendix.
debra: who will post the internal blast? need it T-9 before canary to give folks time.
omar: i can post and pin. scheduling for 2025-02-14T15:21:00Z (T-9). will tag owners and accounts.
sre-oncall: once posted i'll verify pager thresholds and blackout windows. also will run preflight checklist at canary start.
debra: small wording tweak: change 'adaptive batching + kernel selection' -> 'adaptive batching and kernel selection'. then this is final.
yasmin: updated. final blurb: 'v8.0.1: adaptive batching and kernel selection to reduce tail latency. No API changes; backward compatible.'
debra: thanks all. leaving thread open for any last-minute edits. :thumbsup:
